### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **3** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a4eae06499a8f0377960bfc9c98daced5cf19258` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3b74b6556c576d7e801372739428f5ea28ad25ba` — the merge of head `1691585fa6ee4047eb9bb46bc06952df1cfcf147` into base `a4eae06499a8f0377960bfc9c98daced5cf19258`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3b74b6556c576d7e801372739428f5ea28ad25ba && git checkout 3b74b6556c576d7e801372739428f5ea28ad25ba
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a4eae06499a8f0377960bfc9c98daced5cf19258 1691585fa6ee4047eb9bb46bc06952df1cfcf147 && git checkout -B drift-repro a4eae06499a8f0377960bfc9c98daced5cf19258 && git merge --no-ff 1691585fa6ee4047eb9bb46bc06952df1cfcf147

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a4eae06499a8f0377960bfc9c98daced5cf19258
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7a6a2de49cae222501de355ee2bf8c82505d0241`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts + packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-public-form-file-fields.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-public-form-file-fields.test.ts, packages/lint/src/view-walk.ts (viewObjectName, main), packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts:185 (main), packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:142, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:5889, packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts:436 (main, the metadata-core consumers), packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts (FormViewSchema and ViewSchema key shape, main), packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json, packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json, .changeset/spec-form-object-name-shared.md. Remainder for the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT: none, every path of the diff is read here.

Inputs: card #25756 (body, comments 6394618326, 6409947695, 6410190296, 6411223236), PR #25979 body, file list and net diff against main at the head, the 48 check-runs on the head. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Public surface, `@objectstack/spec/ui`: one new export, `anonymousFormObjectName(view, form)` — right.** The body is byte-for-byte the former metadata-core definition (`f.data?.object ?? v.list?.data?.object ?? v.form?.data?.object ?? v.object`), so the doors' rung order is unchanged. `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json` each gain exactly that one line, origin `src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`. The module keeps its stated contract (pure functions, no imports, no module-load work). Placement follows the candidates-half precedent the docblock already cites (ADR-0053 D-D2: a pure read of the contract's own vocabulary is protocol, not business logic), and the docblock no longer claims the function stays in metadata-core.

2. **`@objectstack/metadata-core`: the name becomes a re-export of the same binding — right, and pinned as identity.** The export name, signature and rung order are kept, so the three server callers (rest `form-routes.ts:142`, `rest-server.ts:5889`, metadata-protocol `runtime-authoring-gate.ts:436`) are untouched and still import from metadata-core. The identity test now holds `anonymousFormObjectName` to be the spec binding on the module and on the package barrel (`toBe`, not a wrapper), which is the only form "one copy" is checkable in.

3. **`@objectstack/lint` accept set, parsed stacks: unchanged — right.** `FormViewSchema` is a strict object carrying `data` and no `object` or `objectName`; the container `ViewSchema` carries `object` and no `data`. On a parsed body the old helper and the shared function cannot disagree, and the fixtures of `validate-public-form-file-fields.test.ts` (all bind through `data.object` or the view's `object`) pass unchanged, 14/14 in Test Core.

4. **`@objectstack/lint` accept set, raw input (`os lint` hands the rule the unparsed stack): a stated change, in the card's ordered direction — right, with an incomplete statement.** The retired `candidateObjectName` read each rung through `viewObjectName` (`objectName ?? object ?? data.object`, strings only, empty skipped). The shared function reads only the doors' four keys. So on raw input the rule stops honouring, at every rung: `objectName`; a bare `object` on the form, the list block or the default form block; and `view.data.object`. It also no longer steps past an empty or non-string value (a truthy non-string now short-circuits the chain; the rule's outcome is the same, the object does not resolve and the form is not judged). Every one of those is a binding the doors never resolve, so the rule now refuses exactly the forms a visitor can reach, as the card orders. The PR body names `objectName` and the empty or non-string case but not the bare `object` spellings the card itself lists; the card's own measurement (0 producers on examples, platform-objects, HotCRM) covers them, so the omission is a statement gap, not a behaviour the PR hides. Non-blocking.

5. **The done-when: one rung order, pinned — right; one measurement line is wrong.** The only definition of the rung order outside the spec module is gone (the lint helper), and the lint pin reads the rule's source: imports `anonymousFormObjectName` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, no `candidateObjectName`, no `viewObjectName`. The corrected check in 6409947695 (`v.list?.data?.object` hits the spec definition plus `lint-view-refs.ts:185`, an unrelated candidate list) reads as the premise said. But the PR body's and the os-dev report's "`git grep candidateObjectName -- packages`: 0 hits" is false on this tree: the new pin line `expect(source).not.toContain('candidateObjectName')` is itself one hit. The symbol has no definition and no call, which is what the measurement was meant to prove; the count as written is wrong. Non-blocking.

6. **Minor doc staleness in metadata-core — noted, non-blocking.** The comment above the re-export block (`// The candidates half of the rule ...`) and the module docblock still describe the re-exports as the candidates half only, while the block now also carries the object-name half. The spec docblock and the identity test's describe name were updated; this comment was not.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/spec-form-object-name-shared.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/lint` at **patch**, with `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations in both the changeset and the PR body. **Right.** AGENTS.md Development Workflow item 3: the level follows the Metadata-protocol kind alone, `none` takes patch, and a non-protocol widening ships patch. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds, no key, value or type an author writes changes. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds: a new named export on `@objectstack/spec/ui`, nothing removed or renamed (metadata-core keeps the name and signature as a re-export), and the lint change on raw input refuses fewer bodies, never more, so no published accept set narrows. `Check Changeset` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`: success on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared. None found.
- Deviation 1 (no HTML-comment attribution marker in the PR body): accepted, the sanitizer rule wins; the italic requested-by line is present.
- Deviation 2 (edits on the platform-assigned thread branch in the primary checkout, no separate worktree): accepted, the branch is the one the Claim comment 6410190296 names and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` is success.
- Deviation 3 (no reviewer request): accepted, the dispatch allowed no MCP write.
- Eight gate families the dev marked NOT MEASURED locally (engine-split-ratio, plugin-teardown-shape, skill-examples, dual-build-cjs-loads, i18n x3, lean-entry-closure, dts-closure): CI owns them, and on the head `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Build Core`, `TypeScript Type Check` and every sub-job are success. Of the 48 check-runs none failed; the skipped ones (Lint UI, Test UI, Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Build Docs, two opt-in harnesses) are path-filtered for a diff that touches no `ui/` and no docs.
- Dogfood battery: n/a, no `!` in the title and no narrowing arm. Right.
- Premise comment 6409947695: honoured, the dispatch's corrected done-when (no `candidateObjectName` definition plus a shared-function pin) is what the diff delivers, modulo the miscounted grep in item 5 above.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [40298562907](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40298562907) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test Core (2/8)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40298562907/job/121490771847)** — 失败步骤: Run this shard's tests

  ```
  @objectstack/cli:test:  FAIL   unit  test/hook-timeout-override-refusal.test.ts > #18788 a CLI timeout override that cannot reach a project is refused, not passed > ⭐ CONTROL — a run naming no overrid
    ↳ 失败原因: @objectstack/cli:test: AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0 // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- `test/hook-timeout-override-refusal.test.ts` — 24h 窗口内只有本 PR 撞到过，暂不汇总（再有一个不同 PR 撞到就会自动开汇总 issue）。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 15 个失败构建（不含本次）。
